text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I decide to watch Air Groove
as she
does some solo dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four. One, two, three,
four!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove's dance skills are,
unsurprisingly, top
notch. However...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is there something you'd like to say?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If something is on your mind, speak up.
You're
not holding back because you're
afraid, are you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that the hesitation I'm feeling
is as
clear as day to her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, that's a bold piece of
criticism.
choice_data_list: You can make it even more powerful.
We should be able to refine it even further.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well, I'll bite. Explain yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain what aspects of the dance
could be
expressed with more energy
and power.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Your reasoning is sound enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not so fast!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have to put your advice into practice.
Your job
is to stay here until it's been
properly executed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your eyes had better be glued to me.
choice_data_list: You're definitely right about that, huh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the end of the session, Air Groove is
putting
far more power into her dance,
thus improving
her routine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sophistication? That's not a word you'd
use
without a good reason.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You need to be more specific. I'm
assuming you
have something in mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain what aspects of the dance
could be
expressed with more finesse
and grace.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. I see what you mean. Not a bad
idea.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too pleased with yourself just
yet, you
dunce!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to implement your advice, and
I expect
a full dissection of my
performance after.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your job is to point out any flaws and
help me
achieve perfection. Don't blink!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the end of the session, Air Groove is
instilling
more intent into her dance,
thus improving her
routine.
